rule: Apply every supported descriptive label. For the single stopping-decision cause, take the first supported label in decision_precedence. ENVIRONMENT_FAILURE controls only if candidate execution is disproven; otherwise label it additionally and continue classification. A gate can reject only on its prospectively frozen acceptance role.

classes.definition: Candidate violates an observable behavior or interface entailed by the frozen objective.
classes.inclusion_rule: A frozen semantic oracle fails on the exact candidate and the assertion follows from objective text or an explicitly frozen public contract.
classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude expected file, symbol, algorithm, import shape, or unspecified edge-resolution behavior.
classes.tie_break: HARNESS_MISMATCH controls when entailment is absent or contradicted.

classes.definition: A gate demands or omits a condition inconsistent with, or not entailed by, its frozen objective/measurement contract.
classes.inclusion_rule: Provide a concrete conforming counterimplementation rejected by the gate, or bind contradictory frozen text.
classes.exclusion_rule: Do not use merely because focused and full gates disagree.
classes.tie_break: Controls over TASK_FAILURE and ORDINARY_VALIDATION_FAILURE for that assertion; historical acceptance remains unchanged.

classes.definition: The frozen full repository gate executes the candidate and returns nonzero for a repository contract outside the focused objective oracle.
classes.inclusion_rule: Exact command, candidate identity, exit status, and raw output show the repository check failed.
classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude non-execution caused solely by environment and focused-only failures.
classes.tie_break: May coexist with TASK_FAILURE; more specific structural or mismatch labels describe their own assertions.

classes.definition: A candidate violates a prospectively frozen invariant under its frozen measurement.
classes.inclusion_rule: Recomputed measurement on the bound candidate satisfies the invariant's predeclared violation predicate.
classes.exclusion_rule: Counts, topology changes, or manual concern without a frozen predicate are insufficient.
classes.tie_break: Independent evidence; it rejects only if preregistration makes the invariant an acceptance gate.

classes.definition: A required tool/resource is unavailable or unstable independently of candidate semantics.
classes.inclusion_rule: T0/control reproduction or output proves the candidate was not exercised or the same external failure occurs unchanged.
classes.exclusion_rule: Do not relabel candidate-relevant failure because an environmental error also appears.
classes.tie_break: Retry only if non-exercise is proved; mixed candidate/environment output does not erase other labels.

classes.definition: The frozen measurement cannot observe or resolve a property needed for the research inference.
classes.inclusion_rule: The preregistration marks it unmeasurable or a deterministic counterfixture demonstrates observational aliasing.
classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude ordinary candidate defects and assertions that can be repaired by clarifying a non-scientific test oracle.
classes.tie_break: Blocks the affected inference; it does not automatically reject task acceptance unless frozen as a gate.

historical_applications.qualification: Run 1 labels describe the mixed second full-gate output; evidence cannot establish which failures would remain in a fully provisioned environment. Run 2 classification follows C-1 and does not reverse rejection.
